items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Fred Bess. Well, we all got together and made a little seven piece band.

ctx.x: And, uh, well we picked up on little John Casney and me, Red Island, John Casney, old man Albert Glenny, Fred Bess. Well, we all got together and made a little seven piece band.
